build.description: Build the TeamCode debug APK with Gradle
build.template: Build the FTC robot controller app: run ./gradlew assembleDebug from the project root (if the system Java is too old for Gradle 9, use Android Studio's bundled JBR as JAVA_HOME instead). Report success or the full compile errors.

deploy.description: Install the built APK to the connected robot controller
deploy.template: Find the freshly built TeamCode debug APK under TeamCode/build/outputs/apk/debug/, verify a device is attached with adb devices, then install it with adb install -r. Report the result.

review.template: Review the current git diff for correctness and FTC-specific pitfalls (hardwareMap names matching the robot config, all hardware fetched during init, telemetry kept light in loops). Comment only on real issues.
